definitions.explanation: The common name for Japan's government-run public employment security offices, which help people find jobs and claim unemployment benefits.

examples.japanese: ハローワーク⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: To look for a job at Hello Work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失業|しつぎょう}→失業：03179_shitsugyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、ハローワーク⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Since I lost my job, I went to Hello Work for advice.

examples.japanese: ハローワーク⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{職業|しょくぎょう}→職業：03245_shokugyou⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧や⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けられる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: At Hello Work you can get career counseling and job referrals.

notes:
A wasei-eigo coinage from English "hello" + "work," used as the public nickname for the {公共職業安定所|こうきょうしょくぎょうあんていじょ} (also called {職安|しょくあん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ハローワーク⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to make repeated visits to Hello Work
- ハローワーク⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧: job listings at Hello Work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {職業安定所|しょくぎょうあんていじょ}: employment security office — the formal name
- ⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧: job-listing website — private online alternative
